messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I'm not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you give me the store ID or the full address so I can make sure I'm transferring to the right location?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores]
CALLER: I don't have the address on me, man. It's just the Harbor on Main, near my place in Lakeview. There's really more than one?
AGENT: Let me search for Harbor stores in Lakeview to see what we have. We have three Harbor locations in Lakeview on Main. Which one is closest to you: Downtown at 120 Main, University at 2250 Main, or North Main at 5400 in the Northgate Mall?  [system actions: find_stores]
CALLER: Man, I don't know all that, I just know it's near Oak Street.
AGENT: Perfect, that's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me pull up your prescriptions and transfer those two for you. I'm not seeing any prescriptions on file for you at Harbor. Your albuterol and sertraline are at Brightway 4471 in Columbus, so they're in their system, not ours yet. To move them here, the Harbor pharmacy on Main near Oak Street will need to call Brightway and request the transfer on their end. Can you stop by that store, or would you like me to flag our pharmacist to reach out to them?  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, just have your pharmacist call and grab it, that's easier for me. That's the University one near Oak, right?
AGENT: Yes, that's the University one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me flag our pharmacist to call Brightway and request those transfers. Done. Our pharmacist will call Brightway to request those transfers. Once they confirm, your albuterol and sertraline will be ready at the Harbor on Main near Oak Street. You should hear back within a business day or so.  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback]
CALLER: Cool, that works. Thanks for sorting that out, man.
AGENT (LATEST): You're welcome, Jamal. Have a good one!

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent first asks which Main St store he means without offering options
move_2: the agent asks him to look up the address
disclosure_1: the agent first asks which Main St store
stop_0: Agent confirms both transfers to H-302 with its address.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent offered three store options, not without offering options"}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "Latest turn doesn't ask for address lookup"}, "disclosure_1": {"met": false, "why": "That question occurred earlier, not in latest turn"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No store ID H-302 or address confirmation given"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of emergency or 911 in latest turn"}}
